definitions.explanation: An event at which visitors sample drinks — wine, sake, beer, or coffee — usually hosted by a maker, brewery, or shop to introduce products. The food equivalent is {試食会|ししょくかい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試飲会|しいんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a wine tasting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧、⟦{酒蔵|さかぐら}→酒蔵：08633_sakagura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{試飲会|しいんかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A tasting event will be held at the sake brewery this coming weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{地|じ}⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試飲会|しいんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: More than a hundred people gathered for the tasting of the new local beer.

examples.japanese: {試飲会|しいんかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I bought a bottle of the sake I liked at the tasting and took it home.

notes:
The suffix ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ turns an activity into an organized event, and ⟦{試飲|しいん}→試飲：08048_shiin⟧ (trial drinking) is itself a common noun on shop signs and product labels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試飲会|しいんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a tasting event
- {試飲会|しいんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to take part in a tasting
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧{試飲会|しいんかい}: free tasting event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{試食会|ししょくかい}→試食会：30210_shishokukai⟧: food tasting event — the same word formed with {食|しょく} for eating
- ⟦{発表会|はっぴょうかい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧: presentation event — another common ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ compound, for showing rather than sampling
